subject: cult-info-f
title: CULT.INFO.F.----PR.TRS.
description: Diagram opening R(AS)CM(I)-24. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'find a way to align this phenomenon with the factors that control the vibrational lining of American culture (and in this context, big business cannot make money).' The crossing diagrams how culture-information-focus structurally meets PR-TRS at the corporate-recording-of-creative-music scale: CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) crossed with PR-TRS. CULT-INFO-F sits on the left with the subject-arrow; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) labels a point on the main line, which runs on to PR-TRS, partner-axis at right. RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and POL-DY (political dynamics) branch from the stretch between CULT-INFO-F and PROG-CONT, with (R)PART (the reality of participation) branching from POL-DY. (P)RE-ST (the point of idea completion of restructuralism) rises from PROG-CONT, with APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) branching from it. ALT-DEF (alternative definitions) hangs from the stretch between PROG-CONT and PR-TRS; TR (transformation) branches from ALT-DEF, and STF (source transfer) from TR.
